style: icon-first accent animation, purple/black brand system, minimal text, one dominant motif: a continuously-spinning line-art gear symbolizing an always-on system

customize.note: No catalog block matched a gear/cog rotation icon or a 24/7 badge pop (searched: 'gear cog rotation icon spin', '24/7 badge clock icon' — see catalog-search-miss log below). Hand-authored per builder-contract: procedural line-art SVG gear (ring + 8 teeth + hub, no external icon font/network dependency), single finite GSAP rotation tween (power1.inOut, no repeat) spanning from just after entrance to the exact end of data-duration, and a hand-built upright badge (sibling element, never nested inside the rotating node) with a quick scale/glow pop mirroring the emphasis-glow pattern already used in shared-lead-problem / demand-reputation-flywheel.

content.logo: inline hand-authored line-art gear/cog SVG (#gear-icon) — not an external asset, built from primitive shapes for deterministic offline render

scenes.motion: bg-fill fades in once (persists, never exits); gear-stage scale+fade entrance (back.out); gear-icon begins a single continuous finite rotation tween (power1.inOut) immediately, running uninterrupted through the end of the composition
badge (sibling of the rotating gear-icon, so it stays upright/readable) scale-pops in with back.out, then a quick glow pulse up and back to a resting glow; gear keeps spinning underneath
label fades/slides in beneath the gear (power2.out); gear continues spinning, badge stays upright and readable
label holds frozen for a clean cut; gear may keep gently spinning into the final frame (rotation tween is scheduled to end exactly at data-duration, so nothing is left running past the render window)

shot_brief: A ~5s icon-focused accent piece: the background fill fades in once and never drops out, then a clean purple line-art gear/cog scales into frame and immediately begins a slow, continuous, constant-feeling rotation that runs for the rest of the piece — the single dominant motif, standing for a system that runs 24/7. About a second in, a small upright '24/7' badge pops onto the gear's edge with a quick scale + glow, staying fixed and readable even as the gear turns beneath it (it is a sibling element, never a child of the rotating node, so it never inherits the rotation). A short Montserrat label, RUNNING WHILE YOU SLEEP., fades in beneath the gear around 2s and holds through the final second for a clean cut, while the gear keeps turning underneath it right to the last frame.
